content.title: Gates 401-1829 Hydraulic Hose - 2-Wire Braid, SAE 100R2 / EN 853 2SN, 130 mm Min Bend Radius
content.short_description: Gates 401-1829 is a two-wire braid reinforced hydraulic hose built to SAE 100R2 / EN 853 2SN, with a minimum bend radius of 130 mm.
content.long_description:
Gates 401-1829 hydraulic hose uses a 2-wire braid reinforcement construction, meeting both SAE 100R2 and EN 853 2SN specifications. This dual-standard compliance allows the hose to be specified in applications that call for either the SAE or EN designation for medium-to-high pressure hydraulic lines.

The hose has a minimum bend radius of 130 mm, a key parameter for routing in confined equipment layouts and for avoiding kinking or premature wear at fitting connections. The 2-wire braid design provides the reinforcement layer structure typical of 100R2/2SN class hose, supporting hydraulic fluid transfer in mobile and industrial equipment circuits.

Part number 401-1829 should be cross-referenced against the original equipment hose spec (bore size, working pressure, and burst pressure ratings per SAE 100R2 / EN 853 2SN tables) prior to installation to confirm fitment for the intended system.
bullets: Suitable for hydraulic fluid transfer applications requiring dual SAE/EN spec hose
